name: hometown
description: Hometown: a 3D online property-trading party game set in Stockholm.

scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @hometown/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @hometown/server" "npm run dev --workspace @hometown/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
